cases.prompt: Reply exactly ATTENTION or HEALTHY. Backup job failed; the web service is healthy. Does the backup job require attention?

cases.name: source-summary
cases.prompt: Use only these sources. [A] January: port 7000. [B] February correction: port 7001 replaces 7000. Reply exactly 7001 [B].

cases.name: abstain
cases.prompt: The supplied record gives service name backup but no execution time. Return exactly UNKNOWN for its execution time.
